facts.text: Prove your identity with one document such as a valid U.S. passport or a birth certificate.
Prove California residency with documents such as a utility bill or a bank statement.
A REAL ID application accounts for two residency documents (second residency).
Use the interactive REAL ID document checklist to gather the documents you need.
Complete the application online, then bring the original documents and your confirmation code to the office visit.

real-id-docs.sourceNote: REAL ID overview page and step 1 of the REAL ID checklist.

facts.text: To make an appointment, choose a service such as renewing a DL/ID with changes or an in-person requirement.
Begin the appointment process with the Start Application step.
The Know Before You Go notice says counter service is not offered for license renewal unless your notice says so.
An existing appointment can be reviewed or cancelled through View Appointment.
Check office wait times before you go to the DMV.

renew-appointment.sourceNote: Appointments landing page and select-appointment-type page (rendered text).

facts.text: You can renew a standard driver's license in person at a DMV office.
Bring the DMV renewal notice mailed to you, or complete a DL or ID card application.
At the office, have your thumbprint scanned, pass a vision exam, and have your photo taken.
Save time at your office visit by starting the renewal online first.
Renew at a DMV office if your renewal notice tells you to renew there.

renew-office.sourceNote: Renewal hub page and the online-renewal page office section.

facts.text: You may be able to renew a standard driver's license or ID card online.
Online renewal is possible within 90 days before, or up to 12 months after, the expiration date.
You cannot renew online if you are applying for a REAL ID for the first time.
If you did not get a renewal notice, you can request a copy or sign up for paperless renewal notices.
Start the renewal online through the online renewal option.

renew-online.sourceNote: Renewal hub accordions and the driver-license online-renewal page.
